title: Heating-Household Reduction on Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewals
content:
On a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal within its term, the heating-household reduction depends on the therms billed on energy lines of cycles starting later than the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date: 0.0120 per therm when they total 900 or more, 0.0060 per therm when they total 500 or more but below 900, and no reduction below 500. The reduction lowers the renewal rate by that amount per therm.

The usage counted is the therms on the agreement's energy charge lines whose billing cycle starts after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date.

| Therms on energy lines of cycles in the window | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|
| 900 or more | 0.0120 |
| 500 to 899 | 0.0060 |
| below 500 | none |

### Cases (hypothetical; acceptance date 15 August 2025)

- Energy lines of cycles starting 16 August 2024 onward total 905 therms: 0.0120.
- They total 899 therms: 0.0060.
- They total 499 therms: none.
- A 150-therm line whose cycle starts 15 August 2024 is outside the window and is not counted.
